commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Mahdi Camara (Brest) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+1' Mahdi Camara (Brest) covers his face with his hands after wasting a glorious chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker wide of the left post.
90+1' Brest earn a corner.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Brest couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Matz Sels (Strasbourg) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.

86' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Marco Bizot pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
85' Romain Del Castillo will be replaced by Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
84' The corner from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is cleared away by the defence.
80' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Moise Sahi Dion plays it into the box, and Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 1:1.

79' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
79' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) replacing Kevin Gameiro.
78' A substitution has been made. Marvin Senaya is replaced by Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg).
78' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
74' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
72' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
71' It will be a substitution. Steve Mounie (Brest) is ready to enter the pitch as Martin Satriano walks off.
71' Jeremy Le Douaron comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
70' It is time for a substitution. Angelo (Strasbourg) is on for Dilane Bakwa.
70' Here is a change. Habib Diarra is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg).
70' One of the Brest players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
65' Here comes a substitution. Kamory Doumbia is given a rest as he is replaced by Mahdi Camara (Brest).
63' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
63' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
60' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
59' The possession of the ball – 59:41.
57' A clumsy foul by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle.
55' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
54' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) picks up an injury.
53' A spell of possession for Brest in an attempt to control the game.
48' Martin Satriano (Brest) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
46' The whistle blows and Jeremie Pignard starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
41' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
40' Brest keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
36' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Emanuel Emegha.
35' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
34' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

30' A pass travels right across the box to Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Marco Bizot denies him with a decent save.
28' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
24' Lilian Brassier (Brest) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
23' Looks like Lilian Brassier (Brest) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

22' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
20' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Marco Bizot, who makes a comfortable save.

17' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Matz Sels. This effort really didn't trouble him.
16' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
16' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Brest win a corner.
13' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
10' The resulting corner from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

10' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
6' Kenny Lala (Brest) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
4' The Strasbourg players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
